# Dilemma v3.10.0

The Polish and English player guides are now general introductions to quizzes. Current fees and penalties remain in the quiz interface. New guides have no Refresh button; existing bot guides are discovered and converted once. Publishing still requires Manage Server or the Dilemma manager role.

Dilemma posts separate PL/EN release news on each guide channel after the running version is published on GitHub. Saved delivery receipts prevent ordinary restart duplicates and multiple guides on one channel produce one announcement per version. Discovery and temporary delivery failures resume with backoff.

The owner's private quiz-report summaries now show each reporter's username when available, profile link, account ID and full submitted description. Identical reports retain their authors. Large deliveries are paginated in bounded groups and failed groups reuse cached analysis. The report form explains who receives the account and description; recognizable sensitive details remain redacted and reporter identity stays outside AI input.

Apply the additive `20261117160000_guide_release_updates` migration, regenerate the Prisma client and re-register Discord commands when upgrading from v3.9.0. Review the general guide and bilingual player release highlights before every future release.
